'''Yol Saan''' was a [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] who [[Gambling/Legends|gambled]] at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="Allies" /> in [[44 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'' to [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].</ref> The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Kitaya Shuul]] witnessed Saan cheating while he was gambling at the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and noted to herself that he was a skilled cheat who lost just often enough to avoid being discovered.<ref name="Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yol Saan appeared in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'', the fifth novel in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series. The book was written by [[Christie Golden]] and published in [[2010]].<ref name="Allies" />
